meta.author:
讚美之泉
詞、曲：曾祥怡

lines.a: 讓我坦然無懼來到施恩座前
lines.b: Your throne of grace draws me to come and seek Your face
In truth and spirit I worship You

lines.a: 親愛的天父 我何等地需要祢
lines.b: My dearest Father, oh, how much I need Your grace

lines.a: 需要更多祢的同在 在我生命
lines.b: Oh, how I need more of You in my life

lines.a: 每一天 我需要祢 祢話語如甘霖
lines.b: I need You, Your living word like honey on my lips

lines.a: 每時刻 我需要祢 聖靈如雨降臨
lines.b: I need You, Your spirit come and fall on me like rain

lines.a: 願我生命單單歸榮耀給祢 耶穌
lines.b: That I may live my life for Your glory and Your fame

lines.a: 每天都更愛祢 永不失去起初愛祢的心
lines.b: That I can live each day falling more and more in love with You alone
I want to love You more
